apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: harbor-tls}
spec:
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: harbor-tls:lab
      imagePullPolicy: Never
      args: ["--cert", "/run/tls/tls.crt", "--key", "/run/tls/tls.key"]
      volumeMounts: [{name: tls, mountPath: /run/tls, readOnly: true}]
  volumes:
    - name: tls
      secret: {secretName: harbor-server-tls, defaultMode: 0400}
